topics.title: Formation & Syntax of the Futur Simple
topics.objective: Form and apply the simple future tense across regular and irregular verbs for predictions, formal commitments, plans, and conditional main clauses.

topics.title: Conditionnel Présent: Polite Requests, Desires, & Potentialities
topics.objective: Construct and utilize the present conditional by combining future stems with imperfect endings to communicate politeness, wishes, advice, and unconfirmed information.

topics.title: Hypothetical Constructions with Si Clauses (Real & Unreal Conditionals)
topics.objective: Formulate Type 1 (open/real conditions) and Type 2 (unreal/present hypothetical conditions) complex sentences governed by the conjunction *si*.

topics.title: Futur Antérieur & Temporal Conjunctions (Quand, Lorsque, Dès que)
topics.objective: Construct the compound future anterior tense (auxiliary in Futur Simple + Past Participle) to express actions that will be completed prior to another future action.
